commands: echo "GHA=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-unset} RUN=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unset} REPO=${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-unset}"; echo "---branch---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---root---"; git rev-parse --show-toplevel

printf 'GHA=%s
' "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-unset}"; printf 'RUN=%s
' "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-unset}"; printf 'REPO=%s
' "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-unset}"; git branch --show-current; git rev-parse --show-toplevel

git checkout -b issue-1198-parse-acs-zero-item-signal 2>&1
git check-ignore .prflow/tmp/x 2>&1 && echo "IGNORED" || echo "not-ignored"
mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/issue-body
gh issue view 1198 --json body --jq '.body' > .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1198.md
scripts/parse-acs.py --body-file .prflow/tmp/issue-body/issue-1198.md > .prflow/tmp/acs-1198.md 2>&1
echo "---acs parsed---"; cat .prflow/tmp/acs-1198.md
lib/test/cloud_writer_contract.py generate 2>&1 | tail; echo "---verify---"; lib/test/cloud_writer_contract.py verify 2>&1 | tail; echo "exit=$?"; git status --short

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1262/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-1 2>/dev/null; git diff main...HEAD > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1262/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-1/diff.patch 2>&1 || git diff main...HEAD | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1262/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-1/diff.patch >/dev/null; wc -l .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1262/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-1/diff.patch
D=".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1262/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-1"; mkdir -p "$D"; git diff main...HEAD | tee "$D/diff.patch" >/dev/null; wc -l "$D/diff.patch"

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1198/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true); echo "trigger=$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID"; if [ -n "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ] && [ -z "${TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID//[0-9]/}" ]; then scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" --reaction hooray 2>&1 | tail -2; else echo …[per-command-truncated]

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
